test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘DESERT’ is coded as ‘415163’ and ‘ARMY’ is coded as 2687’. How will ‘SMART’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

‘DESERT’ is coded as ‘415163’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/152d3d2f22454d32bb6886e249ee4369baaf432bea4311312a20dd981dcde079.png] 

And

‘ARMY’ is coded as 2687’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/272524442df3f3d5c4aac5300d803871df4cfe96bb7434ec1cc1e2b503a16683.png] 

Similarly,

‘SMART’ will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76089b7dc71e549e1ae717acd891744904758208506c1eb82d16ab9f70dae44.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "58263".**
